blocks.content:
After calibration, the watcher is **Ready** but inactive until you start it. **Run now** triggers one immediate run outside the schedule, so you can inspect the first result before you turn on scheduled runs. **Start scanning** is on the **Calibration** tab. It turns on scheduled runs. **Active** in **Standing state** shows that scheduled runs are on. Turn **Active** off to pause without deleting the watcher.

Scheduled runs don't overlap. If a run is already in progress, the next one waits or is skipped.

whenTrue.content:
Pop this guide out into a floating window.

If it's docked in the sidebar, this keeps **Standing state**, **Run now**, and **Active** visible on the right.

blocks.content: To start and run the watcher, complete the following steps:

blocks.hint: Skip if you are already on the Watchers list or a watcher detail page.

blocks.content: Open the watcher you just created.

blocks.hint: Skip if you are already on **Calibration**. On Overview, **Review calibration** also opens this tab.

blocks.content:
Click **Run now**.

This triggers one immediate run outside the schedule, so you can inspect the first result before you turn on scheduled runs.
blocks.hint: Skip if you didn't finish calibration. **Run now** works while the watcher is **Ready**, before you start scanning. Don't click **Delete**.

blocks.content:
Click **Start scanning**.

This turns on scheduled runs.
blocks.hint: Skip if the watcher isn't **Ready**, or if you don't want scheduled runs. **Start scanning** is on the calibration complete banner, not **Start a new conversation** in Assistant chat.

blocks.content: To pause scheduled runs, turn off **Active** in **Standing state**, next to **Run now**.
You triggered **Run now**, started scheduled runs, or skipped these controls. In the next milestone, you'll review the run report.
